## Parameters

```{r}
###
### SOIL PARAMETERS
###

rd <- function(N_flux, u_max) {
  N_flux / u_max
}

# Example usage
N_flux <- 1.65  # or whatever effective flux you define
u_c <- 0.88     # kg N m^-2 year^-1
u_c_B <- 44      # kg N kg-1 year-1
rd_val <- rd(N_flux, u_c)

depth = 0.5

###
### ROOT PARAMETERS
###

# Average biomass when needed
B_root_average = 2.8      # kg
B_myco_average = 2.8      # kg

# TODO: go through an replace these!

# ECM defaults (replace with literature)
myco_diameter <- 1e-5     # m (8 microns - within observed range)
myco_density  <- 330      # kg m-3

# Root architecture
n <- 2.75e6                  # number of roots per crown area
l <- 1.5                  # average root length (mm or m depending on your model)

###
### EXTRA PARAMETERS
###

k9 <- 0.01                # nitrogen gate parameter
k8 <- 2.7                 # uptake-age parameter (years)

C_r = 2
A_c = C_r^2 * pi

k20 <- 2
# TODO: fit this!
k21 <- 0.1

mycorrhized   <- 0.9      # 90% colonisation
investment_m  <- 0.2      # fungi return 30% of N to host

traits <- list(
  k_1 = 0.25,      # diameter scaling (mm * sqrt(m))  → adjust for your species
  k_2 = 0.15,      # cortex scaling 1
  k_3 = 0.02,      # cortex scaling 2
  k_4 = 350,       # cortical density (kg m-3)
  k_5 = 150,       # stele density (kg m-3)
  k_6 = 4,         # max lifespan (years)
  k_7 = 120        # lifespan sensitivity to diameter
)


```

## Equtaions

```{r}

############################################################
## ROOT ARCHITECTURE FUNCTIONS
############################################################

root_diameter <- function(root_length, traits) {
  traits$k_1 / sqrt(root_length)
}

root_density <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  pct_cortex <- (traits$k_2 + traits$k_3 / d)^2
  traits$k_4 * pct_cortex + traits$k_5
}

root_lifespan <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  traits$k_6 * (1 - exp(-traits$k_7 * d))
}

root_mass <- function(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  rho <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  rho * (d/2)^2 * root_length * pi * root_no * 1e-9 * crown_area
}

############################################################
## DEPLETION RADIUS
############################################################

rd <- function(N_flux, u_max) {
  N_flux / u_max
}

############################################################
## SOIL EXPLORATION PER BIOMASS
############################################################

e_u_root <- function(r_d, root_diameter_mm, root_density) {
  d_m <- root_diameter_mm / 1000
  4 * r_d^2 / (root_density * d_m^2)
}

e_u_myco <- function(r_d, myco_diameter_m, myco_density) {
  4 * r_d^2 / (myco_density * myco_diameter_m^2)
}

############################################################
## CROWDING SATURATION FUNCTION
############################################################

S_crowding <- function(B_root, B_myco,
                       root_d_mm, myco_diameter,
                       rho_root, rho_myco,
                       N_flux, u_max,   # for rd calculation
                       C_r = 2, depth = 0.5,
                       k20 = 2, k21 = 1) {
  
  # --- Compute depletion radius ---
  rd <- N_flux / u_max
  
  # --- Compute soil explored per unit biomass ---
  d_root_m <- root_d_mm / 1000  # convert mm -> m
  e_root <- 4 * rd^2 / (rho_root * d_root_m^2)
  e_myco <- 4 * rd^2 / (rho_myco * myco_diameter^2)
  
  # --- Ellipsoid soil volume ---
  V_soil <- (4/3) * pi * (k20 * C_r)^2 * depth
  
  # --- Free soil volume corrected for porosity and existing biomass ---
  V_free <- k21 * V_soil - B_root / rho_root - B_myco / rho_myco
  
  # --- Total explored volume ---
  V_explored <- B_root * e_root + B_myco * e_myco
  
  # --- Saturation function ---
  S <- if (V_explored > V_free) {V_free/V_explored} else 1
  
  return(S)
}

############################################################
## ROOT AND MYCORRHIZAL UPTAKE
############################################################

uptake_core <- function(B_root, B_myco,
                        root_d_mm, myco_diameter,
                        rho_root, rho_myco,
                        N_flux, u_max,
                        C_r = 2, depth = 0.5,
                        k20 = 2, k21 = 1) {

  # --- Compute saturation factor (includes rd and e_root/e_myco internally) ---
  Sval <- S_crowding(B_root = B_root,
                      B_myco = B_myco,
                      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
                      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
                      rho_root = rho_root,
                      rho_myco = rho_myco,
                      N_flux = N_flux,
                      u_max = u_max,
                      C_r = C_r,
                      depth = depth,
                      k20 = k20,
                      k21 = k21)
  
  # --- Compute depletion radius for reporting ---
  rd_val <- N_flux / u_max
  
  # --- Compute soil explored per unit biomass ---
  d_root_m <- root_d_mm / 1000
  e_root <- 4 * rd_val^2 / (rho_root * d_root_m^2)
  e_myco <- 4 * rd_val^2 / (rho_myco * myco_diameter^2)
  
  # --- Final uptake ---
  # K = 0.2
  U_root_c <- B_root * u_max * Sval
  U_myco_c <- B_myco * u_max * Sval
  
  U_root <- U_root_c
  U_myco <- U_myco_c
  
  # --- Return all relevant info ---
  list(
    U_root = U_root,
    U_myco = U_myco,
    Sval = Sval,
    rd = rd_val,
    e_root = e_root,
    e_myco = e_myco
  )
}


############################################################
## AGE EFFECT AND NITROGEN GATE
############################################################

uptake_age <- function(age, k8) {
  1 / (1 + exp(age - k8))
}

nitrogen_gate <- function(root_no, root_length, root_diameter) {
  SA <- root_no * pi * root_length * root_diameter
  SA / (SA + k9)  # k9 should be defined in traits/config
}


############################################################
## WHOLE-PLANT UPTAKE
############################################################
plant_uptake <- function(N_flux, crown_area, B_root, B_myco, root_length, root_no,
                         traits, mycorrhized, investment_from_tree, age,
                         myco_diameter, myco_density, crown_radius, depth = 0.5,
                         u_max) {
  
  core <- uptake_core(B_root, B_myco, root_length, root_no, traits,
                      myco_diameter, myco_density, N_flux, u_max,
                      crown_radius, depth)
  
  age_factor <- uptake_age(age, traits$k_8)
  gate <- nitrogen_gate(root_no, root_length, root_diameter(root_length, traits))
  
  uptake_total <- age_factor * ((1 - mycorrhized) * core$U_root +
                                mycorrhized * gate * investment_from_tree * core$U_myco)
  
  return(list(
    N_total = uptake_total,
    U_root = core$U_root,
    U_myco = core$U_myco,
    S = core$Sval,
    r_d = core$r_d
  ))
}

```

## e_u plots

```{r}
# --- Parameters ---
root_d  <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000   # m
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)          # kg/m^3
myco_d  <- myco_diameter                     # m
myco_rho <- myco_density                     # kg/m^3

# Flux values (x-axis)
N_flux_vals <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 200)

# u_max values (grouping)
u_max_vals <- c(0.44, 0.88, 1.32)   # kg N m^-2 yr^-1

# Depletion radius function
rd <- function(N_flux, u_max) N_flux / u_max

# --- Compute all values ---
df <- expand_grid(N_flux = N_flux_vals, u_max = u_max_vals) %>%
  mutate(
    r_d = rd(N_flux, u_max),
    e_r = 4 * r_d^2 / (root_rho * root_d^2),
    e_m = 4 * r_d^2 / (myco_rho * myco_d^2),
    ratio = e_m / e_r,
    u_max = factor(u_max)
  )

p_root <- ggplot(df, aes(N_flux, e_r, colour = u_max)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Root e_u (m^3 / kg)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

p_myco <- ggplot(df, aes(N_flux, e_m, colour = u_max)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhiza e_u (m^3 / kg)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

p_rd <- ggplot(df, aes(N_flux, r_d, colour = u_max)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Depletion radius r_d (m)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

p_ratio <- ggplot(df, aes(N_flux, ratio, colour = u_max)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhiza / Root e_u (ratio)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

# --- 2x2 layout ---
(p_root | p_myco) /
(p_rd   | p_ratio)


```


## Plots, Crowding Saturation S(B_tot)

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# 1. N_s values and root ranges
# ===============================================================
N_flux_vals <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 5)
n_vals <- seq(1e1, 1e7, length.out = 20)
l_vals <- seq(0.05, 2.0, length.out = 20)

# ===============================================================
# 2. Base biomass for roots only
# ===============================================================
df_n_base <- tibble(
  n = n_vals,
  l = 1.5
) %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, 100, traits),
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(l, traits)
  )

df_l_base <- tibble(
  l = l_vals,
  n = 2.75e6
) %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, 100, traits),
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(l, traits)
  )

# ===============================================================
# 3. Add S values for roots only (n-driven and l-driven)
# ===============================================================

df_n <- df_n_base %>%
  tidyr::crossing(N_flux = N_flux_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = 0,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = 2,
      depth = 0.5,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_l <- df_l_base %>%
  tidyr::crossing(N_flux = N_flux_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = 0,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = C_r,
      depth = depth,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 4. Add mycorrhiza contributions
# ===============================================================

df_n_myco <- df_n %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_myco = B_root,  # assume same biomass for simplicity
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_myco,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = 2,
      depth = 0.5,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_l_myco <- df_l %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_myco = B_root,
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_myco,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = C_r,
      depth = depth,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 5. Prepare plotting data
# ===============================================================
df_n$myco <- "no myco"
df_n_myco$myco <- "myco"
df_combined_n <- bind_rows(
  df_n %>% select(B_root, N_flux, S_value = S, myco),
  df_n_myco %>% select(B_root, N_flux, S_value = S, myco)
)

df_l$myco <- "no myco"
df_l_myco$myco <- "myco"
df_combined_l <- bind_rows(
  df_l %>% select(B_root, N_flux, S_value = S, myco),
  df_l_myco %>% select(B_root, N_flux, S_value = S, myco)
)

# ===============================================================
# 6. Plots
# ===============================================================
# --- p1: Root Biomass vs n ---
p1 <- ggplot(df_n_base, aes(n, B_root)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Root Biomass from n",
       x = "Number of roots (n)",
       y = "Biomass (kg)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# --- p2: Root Biomass vs l ---
p2 <- ggplot(df_l_base, aes(l, B_root)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Root Biomass from l",
       x = "Root length (m)",
       y = "Biomass (kg)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# --- p3: Crowding S vs Biomass (n-driven) with line type for myco but no legend ---
p3 <- ggplot(df_combined_n, aes(B_root, S_value, color = factor(N_flux), linetype = myco)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, show.legend = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Crowding S vs Biomass (n-driven)",
    x = "Biomass from n (kg)",
    y = "S",
    color = expression(N[flux])
  ) +
  guides(linetype = "none") +  # hide legend for line type
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- p4: Crowding S vs Biomass (l-driven) with line type for myco and no color legend ---
p4 <- ggplot(df_combined_l, aes(B_root, S_value, color = factor(N_flux), linetype = myco)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Crowding S vs Biomass (l-driven)",
    x = "Biomass from l (kg)",
    y = "S",
    linetype = "Mycorrhiza"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +  # hide legend for color
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1.25),
    legend.position = "left"
  )


# ===============================================================
# 7. Sensitivity to k21
# ===============================================================

# Single N_flux value for clarity
N_flux_fixed <- 1e-4
k21_vals <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)

df_k21_simple <- df_n_base %>%
  tidyr::crossing(k21_test = k21_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S_k21 = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_root,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux_fixed,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = C_r,
      depth = depth,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21_test
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot S vs B_root for k21 only
p5 <- ggplot(df_k21_simple, aes(B_root, S_k21, color = factor(k21_test), group = k21_test)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Crowding S vs Root Biomass for Different Crowding Parameters",
    x = "Root Biomass (kg)",
    y = "S",
    color = "Crowding Parameter"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Combine into 2x2 panel ---
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)

p5
``` 

## Plot 2 — Root Uptake vs Soil Nitrogen Nₛ

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# 1. N_s values and root ranges
# ===============================================================
N_flux_vals <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 20)
n_vals <- seq(1e1, 1e7, length.out = 20)
l_vals <- seq(0.05, 2.0, length.out = 20)

# ===============================================================
# 2. Base biomass for roots only
# ===============================================================
df_n_base <- tibble(
  n = n_vals,
  l = 1.5
) %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, 100, traits),
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(l, traits)
  )

df_l_base <- tibble(
  l = l_vals,
  n = 2.75e6
) %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, 100, traits),
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(l, traits)
  )

# ===============================================================
# 2. Root biomass vs n/l plots
# ===============================================================
p1 <- ggplot(df_n_base, aes(n, B_root)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Root Biomass vs Number of Roots", x = "Number of roots (n)", y = "Biomass (kg)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_l_base, aes(l, B_root)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Root Biomass vs Root Length", x = "Root length (m)", y = "Biomass (kg)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

# ===============================================================
# 3. Uptake vs Biomass (fixed N_flux = 0.0001, B_myco = 2.8)
# ===============================================================
df_uptake <- df_n_base %>%
  tidyr::crossing(N_flux = N_flux_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_root = uptake_core(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_root,      # fixed mycorrhiza
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c
    )$U_root
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Generate a color palette with same length as N_flux_vals
cols <- viridis(length(N_flux_vals), option = "plasma")

p3 <- ggplot(df_uptake, aes(B_root, U_root, group = N_flux, color = N_flux)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", trans = "log10") +
  labs(
    title = "Root Uptake vs Biomass",
    x = "Biomass (kg)",
    y = "Uptake (kg N)",
    color = expression(N[flux])
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# ===============================================================
# 4. Uptake vs Soil N Flux (N_flux range: 1e-7 to 1e-3, B_myco = 2.8)
# ===============================================================
B_root_vals <- c(2, 3, 4)  # example biomasses
B_myco_fixed <- 2.8

df4 <- tidyr::crossing(
  B_root = B_root_vals,
  N_s = N_flux_vals
) %>%
  mutate(
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(1.5, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(1.5, traits)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_root = uptake_core(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_root,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_s,
      u_max = u_c
    )$U_root
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p4 <- ggplot(df4, aes(N_s, U_root, color = factor(B_root))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Root Uptake vs Soil N Flux",
    x = "Soil N Flux (kg N m-1 year-1)",
    y = "Root uptake (kg N)",
    color = "Root biomass (kg)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = -0.05))

# ===============================================================
# 5. Combine into 2x2 panel
# ===============================================================
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)

```

### Mycorrhiza on it's own
```{r}
# ===============================================================
# 1. Parameters
# ===============================================================
B_myco_vals_base <- seq(0.1, 5, length.out = 20)  # mycorrhizal biomass
B_root_fixed <- 2.8
N_flux_vals <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 5)      # range of N_flux
l_fixed <- l  # your fixed root length
n_fixed <- n  # your fixed root number

# ===============================================================
# 2. Compute uptake for all combinations of B_myco and N_flux
# ===============================================================
df_myco_u_range <- tidyr::crossing(B_myco = B_myco_vals_base, N_flux = N_flux_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_myco = uptake_core(
      B_root = B_root_fixed,
      B_myco = B_myco,
      root_length = l_fixed,
      n_root = n_fixed,
      traits = traits,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_flux,
      u_max = u_c,
      u_max_B = u_c_B
    )$U_myco
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 3. Plot
# ===============================================================
p3_m_range <- ggplot(df_myco_u_range, aes(B_myco, U_myco, color = factor(N_flux))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "Mycorrhizal Uptake vs Mycorrhizal Biomass",
    x = "Mycorrhizal biomass (kg)",
    y = "Uptake (kg N)",
    color = expression(N[flux])
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# ===============================================================
# 3. Uptake vs Soil N Concentration (range of B_myco)
# ===============================================================
Nseq <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 200)
B_myco_examples <- c(0.5, 2, 4)  # kg

df_myco_N <- tidyr::crossing(B_myco = B_myco_examples, N_s = Nseq) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_myco = uptake_core(
      B_root = B_root_fixed,
      B_myco = B_myco,
      root_length = l,
      n_root = n,
      traits = traits,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      N_flux = N_s,
      u_max = u_c,
      u_max_B = u_c_B
    )$U_myco
  )

# ===============================================================
# 5. Plotting
# ===============================================================
p3_m <- ggplot(df_myco_u, aes(B_myco, U_myco)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1, color = "darkorange") +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Uptake vs Mycorrhizal Biomass", x = "Mycorrhizal biomass (kg)", y = "Uptake (kg N)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p4_m <- ggplot(df_myco_N, aes(N_s, U_myco, color = factor(B_myco))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Uptake vs Soil N Concentration", x = "Soil N Flux (kg N m-1 year-1)", y = "Uptake (kg N)", color = "Myco biomass (kg)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = -0.05))

p3_m_range <- p3_m_range +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Uptake\nvs Mycorrhizal Biomass") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p4_m <- p4_m +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Uptake\nvs Soil N Concentration") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ===============================================================
# 6. Combine 2x3 panel (or 2x3 with blank)
# ===============================================================
grid.arrange(p3_m_range, p4_m, ncol = 2)
```

# ===============================================================
